resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy for Resale of Residential Property (Housing Department)

fees.label: Certificate of occupancy for resale of residential property
Residential transfer of ownership inspection (Township Code 12-2.4c, Ord. 17-2023)
fees.quote: A charge of $150 $175 for residential transfer of ownership

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Township's Application for Certificate of Occupancy for Resale of Residential Property and pay the $175.00 non-refundable fee to the Housing Department at Town Hall, 1 Aberdeen Square, Aberdeen, NJ 07747. Call 732-583-4200 ext. 177 to schedule. Also apply separately to the fire district for the fire certificate of occupancy.

evidence.quote: APPLICATION FOR CERTIFICATE OF OCCUPANCY FOR RESALE OF RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY
I AM AWARE I MUST OBTAIN A CERTIFICATE OF OCCUPANCY FOR EACH NEW OCCUPANT FROM THE ENFORCING FIRE DISTRICT AND THE ABERDEEN TOWNSHIP HOUSING INSPECTOR PRIOR TO ANY NEW OCCUPANCY.
unless a Certificate of Occupancy, certifying the building and premises are in compliance with all other ordinances of the Township, shall first be obtained from the Housing Officer of the Township.
Such a Certificate of Occupancy shall be granted or denied within ten (10) days from the date of the application for same.
To date the Housing Department of Aberdeen has issued 704 certificates for resale and rentals and has collected $105,600 in fees.

resale_co.notes: Township Code 12-2.4 (as amended by Ord. 17-2023, adopted December 21, 2023) bars selling or transferring any dwelling unless a Certificate of Occupancy is first obtained from the Housing Officer, and raised the residential transfer-of-ownership fee from $150 to $175; the current resale form also shows $175.00. The form gives phone (732) 583-4200 x177 and lisa.balletta@aberdeennj.org (no title shown). The Construction page lists John Palmer, Construction Official, 732-583-4200 Ext. 177 (john.palmer@aberdeennj.org). Aberdeen also handles code enforcement for Matawan under a shared service, which does not change Aberdeen's own process. Rental-only items (rental certificate of occupancy with a $150 fee under Ord. 18-2023, landlord registration and lead-safe certification for pre-1978 rental units) are not resale requirements.

fire_cert.notes: Aberdeen has two fire districts (LEA registry code D for both). Fire District No. 1 posts a 'Fire Certificate of Occupancy Inspection' form with the state tiers ($45 / $90 / $161) and says a fire certificate is needed for each new occupant along with the Township housing certificate. Township Ordinance 7-2020 also sets the CSACMAPFEC fees at $45 / $90 / $161 in Chapter 14 for the Township. No web page or form was found for Fire District No. 2 (Cliffwood); its contact comes from the NJ DCA fire directory, which lists only District 2's LEA entry. The District 1 form says business days start when payment is made 'to the township' but checks are payable to Fire District No. 1, so confirm where to pay. The District 1 form shown does not list a fire extinguisher; the state dropped it in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19).

open_questions: Which fire district (No. 1 or No. 2) covers the property, and does District 2 use the same form and $45 / $90 / $161 fees?
Does the Housing Department need the fire district certificate in hand before it issues the resale certificate?
How long is the Township resale certificate valid, and is there a reinspection fee?
